body: Unless this is created repeatedly using `SNAME` here is unnecessary, it increases binary size and should only be used in hot paths generally

I suppose this should not increase binary size if I understand StringNames correctly. Such StringName already exists - https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Agodotengine%2Fgodot%20SNAME(%22folding_changed%22)&type=code, so I don't create new StringNames and SNAME here is free (from all sides).

Same with `SNAME("settings_changed")`.
Or am I wrong?

It creates a local static variable, which takes memory, and adds to binary size AFAIK, but also see the note:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63e14e13f972671a43abcf019962129e5cca7d01/core/string/string_name.h#L200-L210
Redundant since it's pulled in from the header file via `texture_editor_plugin.h`.
I removed everything (includes and forward-declaration) that does not break compilation on my side. Please take another look.
